items.name: Add Decision
items.description: Add a new ADR (schema 2.0) interactively.
items.long_description: Detects the project's dominant ADR schema, asks 4-6 questions to populate Stakeholders / Trade-offs Accepted / Validation Criteria, and writes the ADR plus an index update.

items.name: Add Skill
items.description: Document a recurring pattern as a skill.
items.long_description: Interactively scaffolds a new skill under .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md, populated with project-specific examples.

items.name: Add Command
items.description: Create a custom Claude Code slash command.
items.long_description: Interactively defines a new /<your-command> with proper structure under .claude/commands/.

items.name: Commit
items.description: Smart commit with style-aware message generation.
items.long_description: Detects project commit style, asks for confirmation, and generates a commit message that matches existing patterns. Supports --amend.

items.name: Deep Context
items.description: 4-step structured codebase exploration with parallel agents.
items.long_description: Overview + Subsystem agents run in parallel, then Drill and Data Flow agents run sequentially. Cross-repo support optional via --repo.

items.name: Generate PRP
items.description: Plan a new feature with a Product Requirements Prompt.
items.long_description: Walks you through scoping a feature, considering trade-offs, and producing a PRP markdown file in .context/prp/generated/. The PRP is the input to /execute-prp.

items.name: Execute PRP
items.description: Implement a planned PRP step-by-step with progress tracking.
items.long_description: Reads a PRP from .context/prp/generated/, walks through phases, marks tasks complete, and respects ADRs.

items.name: Code Review
items.description: Multi-agent review (compliance, bugs, security) with confidence scoring.
items.long_description: Runs 3 parallel review agents on staged or branch changes and aggregates findings with confidence scores.

items.name: Fix Bug
items.description: Test-driven bug fixing with parallel fix candidates and review.
items.long_description: Investigator + 3 fix candidates (conservative, minimal, refactor) + reviewer. Test-first; selects the best fix.

items.name: Create PR
items.description: Open a PR with auto-generated description and mermaid diagrams.
items.long_description: Detects platform (GitHub via gh / GitLab via glab), summarizes commits, and opens the PR/MR.

items.name: PR Comment
items.description: Add a comment to an existing PR or MR.
items.long_description: Detects platform and posts a comment via gh or glab.

items.name: Bug Reproduction skill
items.description: Skill: how to reproduce a bug before fixing it.

items.name: Git Platform skill
items.description: Skill: detect GitHub vs GitLab and use the right CLI.

items.name: Atlassian MCP
items.description: Jira + Confluence access via OAuth.
items.long_description: Adds Jira issue + Confluence page tools. Requires OAuth login the first time. Run /mcp inside Claude Code to authenticate.

items.name: Grafana MCP
items.description: Dashboards, Prometheus/Loki queries, incidents, on-call.
items.long_description: Wraps the Grafana MCP server. Configure GRAFANA_URL and GRAFANA_API_KEY env vars or use OAuth via Claude Code's /mcp.

items.name: Context7 MCP
items.description: Up-to-date library documentation on demand.
items.long_description: Fetches current docs for libraries/frameworks during coding sessions. Useful when training-data may be stale.

items.name: GitHub CLI
items.description: GitHub CLI for PR / issue automation. Used by /create-pr, /pr-comment.
items.long_description: Required when working on GitHub-hosted repos. /create-pr and /pr-comment delegate to gh.

items.name: GitLab CLI
items.description: GitLab CLI for MR / issue automation. Used by /create-pr, /pr-comment.
items.long_description: Required when working on GitLab-hosted repos. /create-pr and /pr-comment delegate to glab.

items.name: Status line
items.description: Custom status line: 1M context, session metrics, jq fallback.
items.long_description: Drop-in statusline.sh wired into Claude Code's statusline hook. Shows context usage and session info.

items.name: Notification hook
items.description: OS notification when Claude finishes a task.
items.long_description: Triggers a desktop notification (macOS / Linux notify-send / Windows toast) on Claude session stop.

items.name: Batch Operations skill
items.description: Skill: how to batch parallel tool calls efficiently.
